Refuse a 2d logistic normal composition that is not joint by sex

Source: R/utils_setup.R
check_sim_2d_comp.Rd

The 2d logistic normal correlates bins within and across sexes, so it reads one composition stacked over sexes. Aggregated or split by sex, the operating model would cut the bins in half as if they were two sexes, or fail inside the draw. The estimation model refuses the same pairing.

Usage

check_sim_2d_comp(comp_like, comp_type, like_name, type_name)

Arguments

comp_like

Likelihood code per fleet, 4 and 7 the 2d forms.

comp_type

Composition type per year and fleet, or per fleet.

like_name, type_name

Argument names, for the message.

Value

NULL, invisibly. Called for the error it raises.
